Tut.1_Desc: Welcome to Ragnaகண்வenoid! This tutorial will help you get started.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-பேட் to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. அழுத்தவும் 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: Casting Storm Gust has never been easier. பிடியுங்கள் down your skill button (e.g., L1+A). The targeting circle appears. Aim with the right stick. Simply RELEASE the button to cast the spell!
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the வலது ஸ்டிக் slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? பதிவு your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline திருத்தவும்or. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
